name: Xnapper
description: Xnapper is a software that takes beautiful screenshots instantly. It handles backgrounds, text recognition, annotations and more so you can focus on your content.
content:
What is Xnapper?

Xnapper is a native macOS app that allows you to take beautiful, ready-to-share screenshots instantly. With just one click, Xnapper captures your screen and automatically enhances the screenshot with nice backgrounds, padding, rounded corners, and more. The app makes it fast and easy to create professional-looking screenshots without any design skills.

How does Xnapper work?

Using Xnapper is a simple 3-step process:

  1. Snap - Use a custom keyboard shortcut to quickly capture any part of your screen
  2. Preview - Xnapper opens the screenshot in its editor where you can see a live preview as you customize the look
  3. Share - Drag and drop the polished screenshot to share it anywhere or save it to your computer

Xnapper provides a clean, intuitive interface that makes capturing and sharing screenshots a breeze. It's optimized for performance as a native Mac app.

What are Xnapper's key features?

Some of Xnapper's standout features include:

  • Automatic screenshot beautification with modern backgrounds, padding, rounded corners, and shadow effects
  • Ability to change the background to gradients, colors, or images
  • Smart balance tool that perfectly centers your screenshot on the canvas
  • Built-in annotation tools to add arrows, shapes, and text to your screenshots
  • Automatic detection and redaction of sensitive info like emails and credit card numbers
  • Quick sharing options to post your enhanced screenshot to social media or the cloud
  • Support for capturing specific windows, areas, or the full screen
  • Custom keyboard shortcuts for a fast workflow

How much does Xnapper cost?

Xnapper offers several one-time purchase options based on the number of devices:

  • $29.99 for 1 device
  • $54.99 for 2 devices
  • $79.99 for 3 devices

All licenses include one year of free updates. After the first year, you can optionally renew your license at a 40% discount to continue receiving updates. The app is free to download and try, but will include a watermark until you purchase a license.

Xnapper is also available through a Setapp subscription for $9.99/month which provides access to over 230 Mac apps.

Is there an iOS version of Xnapper?

Yes, Xnapper offers an iOS app that brings its beautiful screenshot capabilities to iPhone and iPad. However, the mobile app is a separate purchase and can only be bought through the iOS App Store.

What do users think about Xnapper?

Xnapper has received very positive reviews from users who praise its ease of use, automatic beautification of screenshots, and time-saving features:

"This screenshot app is perfect for sharing on social media. I use it to crop my ugly screenshots, add beautiful backgrounds and share to Twitter. My favorite feature is the automatic padding detection and correction with the inset setting - it makes everything look so much nicer."

"Xnapper is the best screenshot tool for Mac users, saving you time and effort with its advanced features and intuitive user interface."

Many find Xnapper to be the best screenshot app for quickly capturing and sharing professional, visually appealing screenshots on their Mac. The developer is actively improving the app with frequent updates based on user feedback.
